features.title: Any model
features.body: Runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Gemini skills on OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq or local Ollama / LM Studio models.

features.title: Finds what you have
features.body: Discovers the skills and agents already on your PC.

features.title: From your mouse
features.body: Select text anywhere and press the forward side button, or Ctrl+Shift+Space.

features.title: Drag gesture (donut)
features.body: Hold Ctrl and drag text, files or images: a donut of your skills appears at the cursor; drop on a slice to run it.

features.title: Reads dropped files
features.body: Text, code and Office documents are read automatically when you drop them.

features.title: Back where you were
features.body: Insert into app pastes the answer back, or copy it and ask a follow-up.
